fusions.name: Long Fall
fusions.desc: A dive from range that deals 14 damage, up to 2.2 times that at maximum range, and pushes the target back 2 tiles.

fusions.name: Skewering Stoop
fusions.desc: Strikes the first enemy it meets for 32 damage and an extra 6% of a boss's or elite's maximum health.

fusions.name: Longer Lance
fusions.desc: For 20 seconds, your attacks and spells reach 40% further.

fusions.name: Aimed Hold
fusions.desc: After 6 seconds without a critical hit, your physical damage rises by 30% for 4 seconds. Once every 12 seconds.
